## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (or this is a doc/clerical change with no behavior delta).
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies — or, if there are, the rationale is in the description.
- [ ] CHANGELOG impact: covered by Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `BREAKING CHANGE:`).
- [ ] Conventions doc (`docs/conventions.md`) updated if this PR changed a path layout, packaging choice, CLI surface, webhook contract, or release workflow.
